scope: Static source inspection and local PHP runtime validation of the current workspace; no code changes made.

findings.description: Fallback ConvertAPI secret remains in server-side PHP source and TLS verification is disabled.
evidence: api/convert-pdf-to-word.php: fallback secret assignment is present
api/convert-pdf-to-word.php: CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER is set to false
api/convert-pdf-to-word.php: CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYHOST is set to false
findings.recommended_action: Rotate/revoke the current ConvertAPI secret, move it to environment variables, and re-enable TLS verification.

findings.description: The dynamic sitemap generator still emits malformed XML containing literal escaped newline sequences.
evidence: sitemap.php: output begins with echo '\'<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>\n';'
sitemap.php: subsequent echo statements also use literal \n sequences
Runtime validation: the emitted XML was not accepted as clean XML output
findings.recommended_action: Replace the escaped newline output with proper XML generation and validate the generated sitemap as XML before publishing.

findings.description: The current robots.txt contains duplicate wildcard groups and duplicate sitemap declarations.
evidence: robots.txt: User-agent: * appears twice
robots.txt: Sitemap appears twice
robots.txt: Allow and Disallow rules are duplicated across groups
findings.recommended_action: Consolidate the robots directives to one valid User-agent block and one canonical sitemap declaration.

findings.description: The text-comparison aliases remain separate routes and are not consolidated to a single canonical target.
evidence: .htaccess: alias rewrite list includes 10 routes rewriting to views/tools/text-comparison.php
.htaccess: no single canonical target rule is present for the alias set
findings.recommended_action: Choose a canonical route and redirect aliases to it or explicitly decide that each alias is an indexable landing page.

findings.description: The site still has a large number of tool routes outside the registry and still requires a route decision for the 59 unregistered routes.
evidence: includes/category-data.php: smaller registry than the tool directory
views/tools: many tool PHP files exist outside the registry
Current source does not conclusively decide indexation status for all remaining routes
findings.recommended_action: Document the routing policy: register, redirect, or decommission each remaining route.

findings.description: Current source still contains Snapy Tools brand language in legal/info pages.
evidence: views/about.php: page_description still says Snapy Tools
views/contact.php: page_description still says Snapy Tools
views/privacy.php: page_description still says Snapy Tools
views/disclaimer.php: page_description still says Snapy Tools
findings.recommended_action: Replace the stale Snapy Tools brand references with WordsCompare and validate all legal/about text.

findings.description: Current browser-only and no-upload claims are not wholly aligned with the current conversion architecture and external API use patterns.
evidence: llms.txt: describes the toolkit as browser-based
api/convert-pdf-to-word.php: direct external API conversion processing exists
Multiple tool pages invoke external ConvertAPI flows in frontend JavaScript
findings.recommended_action: Reconcile all browser-only and privacy phrasing with actual processing paths before publication.
